## Security verdict: PASS WITH NOTES

PR #180, exact head `8790154bbbe3db0297011c00cebb49739ea283ba`.

Delta-only review from `0ffb883`, restricted to the requested digest/watchdog/tests/docs/skills merge scope. No new security vulnerability was identified; prior receiver safety and lease qualifications stand.

| # | Severity | File | Lines | Vulnerability | Confidence |
|---|----------|------|-------|---------------|------------|
| - | - | - | - | No new vulnerability identified | - |

The footer accurately lists stale cards, refused pane taps, stale extensions and lapsed native receivers (`crates/core/src/pa_digest.rs:179`). Both anomalies survive (`crates/daemon/src/pa_watchdog.rs:1003-1004`).

Stale-extension remains fleet-scoped and harness-filtered, with closed-grammar identifiers or numeric-length fallback for diagnostics (`pa_watchdog.rs:1343-1425`). Receiver-lapsed keeps daemon-derived duration and fixed wording (`:1430-1455`), not seat/refusal-supplied text. Tests and documentation retain both anomalies (`crates/daemon/src/pa_watchdog_tests.rs:1862,2099`; `docs/how/pij-rs-api.md:1956-1957`; `docs/difficulties.md:129-130`; `skills/pij/references/prime/pa.md:41`).

No new C19/C21 secret, private-path, refusal-body or raw diagnostic prompt exposure was identified. Prior uncertainty/rearm and session barriers are unchanged. The ten-minute escalation still covers only empty-idle uncertainty; other blocked-state heartbeat behavior remains a correctness limitation.

GitHub metadata and the independent remote pull ref agree on the full reviewed SHA; GitHub reports CLEAN. CI run `42452702429` and Delivers run `42452702389` both identify this SHA and success.

No local tests, builds, injections, probes, credential reads or mutations were performed.
